newsitem.title: GREECE: MORE VOLATILE SPOT DRACHMA SPARKS IMPLIED VOLS.
newsitem.headline: MORE VOLATILE SPOT DRACHMA SPARKS IMPLIED VOLS.

text.p: The greater volatility of spot drachma since the start of 1997 has been reflected in implied ecu/drachma, mark/drachma and $/drachma volatilities with demand for ecu puts still outweighing demand for calls, traders said.

"Implied volatilities are on the rise since the beginning of the year due to the spot drachma's more frequent and wider fluctuations," said an options trader at a state bank. "The trend for drachma friendly placements continues."
Long $/drachma calls and puts were balancing out, the dealer said.
The trader said investors were showing interest in buying straddles and time spreads on ecu/drachma, mark/drachma and $/drachma.
Straddles combine calls and puts with the same strike and expiry date while time spreads refer to combinations of buying a put and selling another with the same strike and different expiry dates.
The trader said requests for risk reversals were on the rise since the beginning of the year.
"Risk reversals in ecu/drachma and mark/drachma have been invigorated because of the volatility smile," said an options trader at a state bank.
Risk reversals are quoted wider in favour of ecu/drachma calls.
